# fast boot (test only): Vice: play until the player's captain has taken a Mega Strike, then 40 s more (launch, Mega scene, result, celebration and replay if it scores)
# Generated by tools/gen_fb_routes.py from native/tools/routes/mega_strike_route.txt (its lines from `wait ingame == 1` on); edit the generator, not this file.
# The bootmatch line below sets MSC_BOOT_MATCH (and _OPTS) for the harness: the match is started at the title screen, so no title, menu or launch lines.
# The menu scene marks (@begin menu-main, stadium-select) are gone by design; @begin/@end walkout and play marks are as in the source route.
bootmatch vice:3:6
wait ingame == 1
# A skips the walk-out cutscene (match state 0); state 1 is the kick-off, 5 open play.
mash 100 30 gs == 1
log STATE kick-off
wait gs == 5
log STATE open play
# --- play until the player's captain has taken a Mega Strike (hold Circle for the wind-up, Circle stops the meter) -------
repeat 3500
if cmeterpress >= 1
log Mega Strike meter stopped
log @begin mega-sequence
idle 1200
log @end mega-sequence
log Mega Strike done
exit
endif
if cmode == 2
log Mega Strike meter open
idle 3
vpress circle 3 0
endif
if chave == 1 && cplayer == 0 && cmode == 0 && paused == 0
vchase 15 none goal
try vmash circle 1 cmode == 2 || chave == 0 200
endif
if cmode == 1
try vmash cross 8 cmode != 1 600
endif
if cmode == 3
try vmash select 6 cmode != 3 600
endif
if paused == 1
vpress start 3 30
endif
if chave == 1 && cplayer == 4
vpress cross 3 20
endif
if chave == 1 && cplayer != 4 && cplayer != 0
vchase 10 none goal
vpress cross 3 15
endif
if chave == 1 && cplayer == 0
vchase 20 none goal
vchase 6 circle goal
endif
if chave == 0 && cplayer != 0 && cball != 1
vhold 18 cross
endif
if chave == 0
vchase 12 none ball
endif
idle 2
endrepeat
log Mega Strike never happened
exit
